source.title: Neuropsychiatric Systemic Lupus Erythematosus: A Systematic Review
source.whyItFits: Open systematic review organized around the ACR neuropsychiatric SLE syndromes and the treatment patterns reported for them, including immunosuppression and anticoagulation.

whyItFits: Open systematic review organized around the ACR neuropsychiatric SLE syndromes and the treatment patterns reported for them, including immunosuppression and anticoagulation.
coverageNote: EULAR 2010 NPSLE recommendations were not in PMC. This systematic review is the open full text that covers syndromes and the immunosuppression-versus-anticoagulation split.
